title: Il tutto deponete
subtitle: Fiordiligi, Dorabella, Despina, Ferrando, Don Alfonso and Guglielmo: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 4, recitative after No. 21
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Cos' è on two notes; Parlate!; Madama… and Anzi madame…; fa without its apostrophe). Don Alfonso's incorraggiteli (bar 12) is printed with a double r; the word keeps the printed letters, with the IPA and meaning of incoraggiteli.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 227–228, the recitative between No. 21 and No. 22 (23 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 3, 7, 9, 11, 13, 18 and 22), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. The last bar is printed with two quarters before the double bar and “segue Nr. 22 Quartett”, and is set as 2/4. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100, estimated (no separate timing of this recitative was found; about 1 minute).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
